title: Playboys Latin Jazz Christmas Not So Silent Night CD PROMO Sandoval Sheila E
conditionDescription: Pre-owned. Disc, jewel case and inserts show normal light wear consistent with age and storage. Please review photos for exact condition.
descriptionText:
Playboy's Latin Jazz Christmas: A Not So Silent Night
(Playboy Jazz / Concord Records PBD-7001-2).

PROMOTIONAL COPY - the disc is marked "For promotional use, not for
sale." It plays as a normal CD; noted here for accuracy.

Featuring Ed Calle, Caribbean Jazz Project, Sheila E., Pete Escovedo,
Poncho Sanchez and Arturo Sandoval. Liner note by Hugh M. Hefner.

1. Jingle Bells (5:54) - featuring Ed Calle, Arturo Sandoval and Jaki Sauza
2. Sleigh Ride (4:52) - featuring Caribbean Jazz Project
3. What Child Is This (5:19) - featuring Poncho Sanchez
4. Santa Claus Is Coming To Town (5:53) - featuring Ed Calle and Arturo Sandoval
5. Santa Baby (4:07) - featuring Sheila E.
6. Angels We Have Heard On High (4:58) - featuring Caribbean Jazz Project
7. White Christmas (5:10) - featuring Ed Calle and Don Warner
8. Silent Night (5:58) - featuring Ed Calle and Dan Warner
9. Have Yourself A Merry Little Christmas (4:05) - featuring Poncho Sanchez
10. God Rest Ye Merry Gentlemen (5:14) - featuring Ed Calle and Justo Almario
11. Feliz Navidad (3:41) - featuring Pete Escovedo and Ray Obiedo

Disc, jewel case and pictured inserts are included. You will receive the exact CD pictured.
